entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's ridiculous that I even have to call. This should have been a simple click.
I can certainly look into that for you. I understand your frustration. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF-8675309. And don't give me any runaround. I want my money back, now.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The issue is your company's policies and your broken website! I see you're looking at the date. I know what you're going to say, and I'm telling you right now, I am not accepting no for an answer.
Sir, I do need to inform you that the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols and account activation.

I KNEW IT! That is completely unacceptable! I TRIED to return it on day nine! Your entire website was down! I spent an hour trying to get a label and couldn't print anything because of a massive website error. I want to speak to your manager, this is outrageous. I will plaster this story all over social media.
I understand your anger, and I want to resolve this for you without needing a manager. You said you tried to process the return on day nine because our system was down?
YES! That's what I said! The whole return portal was a joke. It just kept timing out. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I had a feeling you'd pull something like this.

Thank you for clarifying that. Let me check our internal system alerts for that day. One moment... Yes, I am seeing it now. There was a documented, system-wide outage on our return portal eight days ago. I sincerely apologize for that; it was our fault you were unable to process the return.
So you see the problem then? You admit your system was down?

Absolutely. Because of that website error on our end, I am making an exception and approving a full refund for you. You don't need to provide the screenshot; our logs confirm the issue. I am generating a prepaid return label and I will email it to you right now. Once we receive the device, you'll see the full refund in 3-5 business days.
Oh. Well... that's what I wanted in the first place. So a full refund, you're sure?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. The email has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Just get me that label. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for your patience, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
